relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: Knockdown of Nav1.7 expression has demonstrated significant analgesic effects in rodent models of neuropathic pain [24].

relationships.subject: GAD
relationships.evidence_quote: gene transfer of glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD) enhances gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) production and has been shown to reduce neuropathic pain in preclinical models [21].

relationships.subject: H3K27me3
relationships.evidence_quote: This was linked to a decrease in the repressive histone mark H3K27me3 at the MCP-3 promoter region [23].

relationships.subject: IL-10
relationships.evidence_quote: One notable approach involved AAV-mediated delivery of IL-10 to the spinal cord, resulting in suppression of glial activation and reversal of established neuropathic pain [39].

key_findings: Narrative review of gene therapy (Nav1.7 siRNA, GAD/GABA, IL-10, TRPV1) and epigenetic modulation for chronic pain.
Epigenetic changes such as MeCP2 phosphorylation and H3K27me3 loss at MCP-3 promoter contribute to pain hypersensitivity.
